column2: In multiplayer games it affects all players.
column3: Contradicts the card's Oracle text (template error; policy ruling-contradicting-oracle-gives-way, decided by the user Nov 5): the 2004-10-04 ruling says the ability affects 'all players' in multiplayer games, but it triggers only 'Whenever an opponent casts an artifact spell', and a player's opponents are the players not on their team (CR 102.3), never the player. Likely origin: the multiplayer note that the thirteen other cards with one whose abilities apply only to opponents word 'it affects all opponents' or 'all opposing players' (eleven in the same 2004-10-04 batch, e.g. Malignant Growth 'In multiplayer games it affects all opponents.', Aura of Silence, Lifetap, Lifeblood, Powerleech, Underworld Dreams, Havoc, Invoke Prejudice), with 'players' instead, the word the batch uses for abilities that apply to every player (Thieves' Auction, Sphere of Resistance, Spellshock, Dueling Grounds, Crumbling Sanctuary). The engine follows the Oracle text: each opponent's artifact spells count, its controller's don't (tests/rulings/ruling_contradicting_oracle.rs); logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md
